title: Maternal Smoking and Congenital Heart Defects, National Birth Defects Prevention Study, 1997-2011.
authors: Bolin EH, Gokun Y, Romitti PA, Tinker SC, Summers AD, Roberson PK, Hobbs CA, Malik S, Botto LD, Nembhard WN, National Birth Defects Prevention Study.
quote: Results Multiple CHDs displayed modest associations with any level of maternal periconceptional smoking independent of potential confounders; the strongest associations were for aggregated septal defects (OR, 1.5; 95% CI, 1.3-1.7), tricuspid atresia (OR, 1.7; 95% CI, 1.0-2.7), and double outlet right ventricle (DORV) (OR, 1.5; 95% CI, 1.1-2.1).
